source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Each unit gets one use per turn. In a [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), these Warriors can choose a boost if picked to fight or chosen as a target by an enemy unit. For the rest of that phase, raise either the Strength of their melee attacks or the Toughness of the unit by 1.
